data.name: Mermonkey
targeting_extra: Ice Jet ability follows targeting option or locked direction via Monkey Special
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Trident Efficiency
1.text: Trident cooldown -20% (+25% attack speed). With Alluring Melody+: trance pull delay -10%.

1.name: Trident Swiftness
1.text: Cooldown a further -25% (total -40%, +66.67% attack speed); trident speed +50% with reduced lifespan (same max distance). Crosspath effects: Alluring Melody+ pull delay -10% more (-21% total); Riptide Champion+ projectile growth rate +50%; Arctic Knight+ Ice Jet ice ball speed +50%.

1.name: Abyss Dweller
1.text: Abyssal Creature: 8 tentacles, each separate attack at 45 deg apart, 8 Shatter dmg, pierce 15, cd 3s, within a 45 deg cone, mermonkey range. Splash damage 2->4. Grants +10% pierce to all towers in range (not itself or Paragons).

1.name: Abyssal Warrior
1.text: Splashes coat bloons in ink: slow 40% (MOAB/BFB 28%, other MOAB-class unaffected) up to 10s. Tentacles 12 dmg +6 Ceramic, pierce 25 (+35% with Sharper Prongs), 50% larger area, cd 2.5s. Splash 8 dmg. Pierce aura 20%.

1.name: Lord of the Abyss
1.text: Range 28->32; water-based towers can be placed on land within 32 range. Tentacles 32 dmg, pierce 50, double area, cd 1.5s. Tridents attack 2x faster, pierce 2->9, splash 10 dmg. Pierce aura 40%.

2.name: Sharper Prongs
2.text: Trident pierce +1 (3), splash pierce +3 (6). Crosspath: Abyss Dweller tentacles +35% pierce; Alluring Melody trance +2 pierce.

2.name: Tidal Chill
2.text: Splash radius +50%; splashes freeze bloons they damage for 4 layers or 0.5s; not MOAB-class.

2.name: Riptide Champion
2.text: Replaces trident with slower non-splash trident: cd 1.2->1.5s, range 28->32, grows in size/damage while traveling (+50% dmg/s capped 3x, +10% radius/s), spawns 2 lateral wavelets on lifespan end or wall hit. 4 Frigid dmg, +2 vs frozen, pierce 25, freezes all layers 1s (0.5s Ceramic). Pops Lead; passes White/Zebra (not Purple).

2.name: Arctic Knight
2.text: Ability Ice Jet: for 3s stops trident, fires bouncing ice balls (20 dmg, pierce 240, freeze up to 3 layers non-MOAB for 3s, bounce off walls), infinite range by targeting option or locked direction. Cooldown 45s. Trident/wavelet damage 4->8, +4 vs frozen, +8 vs MOAB-class.

2.name: Popseidon
2.text: Ice Jet ice balls 30 dmg and bounce off map edges; ability also floods the map: 70 Frigid dmg to all on-screen bloons (incl. Camo) and 50% slow for 8s (affects bloons it cannot damage). Range 32->40; trident attack speed x2; dmg 8->15, +7.5 vs frozen, +15 vs MOAB; +2 side tridents at 45 deg.

3.name: Echosense Precision
3.text: All attacks detect Camo; tridents home within 80 units from any direction. Rotation rate adjusted by Swiftness/Riptide crosspaths; Arctic Knight ice jet spread 30->10 deg; Popseidon side trident angle 45->60 deg.

3.name: Echosense Network
3.text: +7.5% range to all Echosense Mermonkeys (this upgrade or further on path) per Mermonkey, additive, max 10 stacks (+75%).

3.name: Alluring Melody
3.text: Trance attack on non-MOAB bloons: lose Camo, instantly take remaining DoT damage (cap 50), circle tower anticlockwise 6s then return to prior position; cooldown 12s. Pierce 6 (Ceramic uses 2). Splash pierce 3->9.

3.name: Symphonic Resonance
3.text: Range 28->32. Trance pierce 12 (+2 Sharper Prongs), no extra Ceramic cost, DoT cap 125, can trance MOABs (+2 pierce cost) and DDTs (+3); MOAB-class orbit at 1/3 speed. Monkey Special: place totem anywhere in range to emit trance from; 6s cooldown to re-place.

3.name: The Final Harmonic
3.text: Buff to all Heroes (+15% range, -15% ability cooldowns) and Magic towers (+3 pierce), excluding itself, within totem or Mermonkey range. Range 32->38, splash pierce 9->18, trance cd 3s, DoT cap 10,000, totem placeable anywhere on-screen. Trance affects BFBs/ZOMGs like MOABs; BADs/Bosses only get Camo strip and DoT detonation (no pull).

data.paragon_note: No Mermonkey paragon on wiki at v55.1.
